title: March for Housing Justice
description: Demand affordable housing and an end to predatory evictions. Bring signs and water.

title: Climate Strike: Fossil Fuel Divestment
description: Pressure city pension funds to divest from fossil fuels. Student and worker solidarity.

title: Healthcare is a Right Rally
description: Rally for universal healthcare coverage. Speakers from nurses union and patient advocates.

title: Workers Rise: Fight for $20 Minimum Wage
description: Join fast food, retail, and gig workers demanding a $20 federal minimum wage and the right to organize. Bring your union card or solidarity sign.

title: Protect the Vote: Defend Voting Rights March
description: March to the Georgia State Capitol to oppose voter suppression laws and demand automatic voter registration. Wear comfortable shoes for the 1-mile route.

title: Cancel the Debt: Student Loan Justice Rally
description: Demand full cancellation of federal student loan debt and free public college tuition. Bring your loan statements and personal stories to share with lawmakers.

title: Feed the Community: End Food Deserts March
description: March to demand grocery access, community gardens, and healthy food programs in underserved neighborhoods across LA. Bring canned goods to donate to local food banks along the route.

title: Families Belong Together: Immigration Rights March
description: Rally against family separation and deportation policies, demanding a clear path to citizenship for undocumented residents. Bring signs in English and Spanish and be prepared to march to the federal courthouse.

title: Accountability Now: Police Reform Rally
description: Demand federal legislation for independent oversight boards, body camera mandates, and an end to qualified immunity. Bring ID, know your rights, and connect with legal observer volunteers on-site.

title: Clean Energy Now: Jobs & Justice March
description: Demand a just transition to renewable energy that prioritizes frontline communities and union jobs. Bring signs and join a post-march job fair featuring green energy employers.

title: Mental Health Crisis Rally: Fund Care, Not Cuts
description: Rally against Medicaid cuts to mental health services and demand fully funded community crisis response teams. Bring a friend and share your story — peer testimonials will be presented to city council members.
